name: Caleb Williams
bio: Caleb "CJ" Williams is an American actor. He is best known for his role as Wade in the horror comedy film Buddy (2026).

credits.title: Buddy
credits.overview: Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy - bright orange unicorn - spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.

credits.title: Trife
credits.overview: A homeless father’s desperate act to help his young son after a basketball injury leads to an unexpected shot at redemption.

credits.title: Just One
credits.overview: Struggling musician Amaru meets mischievous ball of energy Shai while performing a low-end gig at his local community center. When Shai’s parents don’t pick him up, Amaru becomes tasked with the job of taking him home. The only problem- Shai doesn’t remember where he lives.
